title: October 28, 1627: a Mughal emperor died travelling home from Kashmir - leaving behind an empire run partly by his wife.
caption:
October 28, 1627: a Mughal emperor died travelling home from Kashmir - leaving behind an empire run partly by his wife.

He had ruled the Mughal Empire since 1605, consolidating its administration while presiding over what's considered the golden age of Mughal painting.

Jahangir also left behind his own memoir, the Tuzuk-i-Jahangiri, giving historians a rare first-person account of Mughal court life, politics and his own reflections, in his own words.

Jahangir's own memoir is part of why Mughal-era India is one of history's best-documented empires - a record-keeping instinct modern India's institutions still carry forward.
